controls.label: Shape model
controls.description: ESA/RMOC MTP019 measured nucleus shape, simplified for display. Neutral gray is a model material, not a photograph or an albedo map. The measured north pole is retained; rotational phase is arbitrary. Solar geometry uses the shared 4 September 2026 epoch.
